items.title: Redesigned Account Switcher
items.subtitle: A full-width bottom sheet in your theme's colours, with larger avatars, a drag handle for reordering and each account's menu on its own ellipsis.

items.title: Profile Picture Shape
items.subtitle: Choose Full, Circle or rounded Square for user pictures across posts, comments, messages and the profile tab. Under Settings > Apollo Reborn > Interface.

items.title: Swipe Tab Bar to Navigate
items.subtitle: On Liquid Glass, swiping the tab bar goes back and forward again, in exchange for the system's drag-to-switch-tab gesture. Off by default, under Interface > Tab Bar.

items.title: Tabs Remember Their Sort
items.subtitle: Reopening a Floating Post Tab from its bubble brings the thread back on the sort you left it on, Live Update included.

items.title: iOS 27 Composer Fix
items.subtitle: The formatting bar above the keyboard no longer sits under it, so the photo, GIF, link and text icons are whole again.
